description: This file defines the ShellContextFactory class responsible for creating and managing shell contexts within the OrchardCore framework. It handles context creation for tenants, including setup and described contexts, utilizing dependency injection, logging, and shell descriptors.

classes.name: ShellContextFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating shell contexts, managing tenant-specific configurations, and initializing modules within OrchardCore.

methods.name: ShellContextFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for the factory.

methods.name: CreateShellContextAsync
methods.description: Creates a shell context for a tenant based on provided settings, handling shared and new contexts.

methods.name: CreateSetupContextAsync
methods.description: Creates a shell context for setup when no existing settings are available.

methods.name: CreateDescribedContextAsync
methods.description: Creates a detailed shell context with a specific shell descriptor, initializing modules and services.

methods.name: MinimumShellDescriptor
methods.description: Generates a minimal shell descriptor used for bootstrapping the first container.
